_comment: Rule-based plain-English needs. Each rule's 'when' maps a field to inclusive {min, max} bounds; all conditions must hold for the rule to contribute its 'need' text. Fields: energy, stress, approachability, confidence, arousal_spikes, jumps_per_min. Rules apply in order; duplicate need texts are de-duplicated. Keep text plain; banned words are rejected by guardrails. 'max_needs' caps how many are kept.

rules.need: owner comfortable with an excitable dog
